question: In January 2022, India’s first para-badminton academy was launched in which state?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India's first para-badminton academy** was launched in **Uttar Pradesh** in January 2022.
 
• This initiative aims to provide world-class training facilities and support for para-badminton athletes in the country.
 
• The academy is equipped with modern amenities and coaching staff to nurture the talent of differently-abled badminton players.
 
• The establishment of this academy marks a significant step towards promoting inclusivity in sports in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Para-badminton** is a variant of badminton for athletes with physical disabilities.
 
• It is governed by the Badminton World Federation (BWF) and follows similar rules to able-bodied badminton, with some modifications to accommodate the players' needs.
 
• India has produced several notable para-badminton players who have excelled in international competitions, bringing laurels to the country.
 
• The launch of the para-badminton academy is expected to further boost the sport's development and help identify and nurture future champions.
